Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
PYTHON DEVELOPER WITH AI - REMOTE 
 Hiring a Python Developer with AI/GenAI experience for a B2B client that automates relationships between vendors, distributors, and resellers. The developer will work on building and improving backend services, APIs, automation features, and AI-powered capabilities using Python.
 Your role: 
 Backend Development: 
Develop, enhance, and maintain backend services using Python, Django, and Django REST Framework (DRF) .
Design and implement scalable, secure, and reusable REST APIs.
Collaborate with product and frontend teams to integrate APIs and ensure smooth data flows.
Have a good understanding of REST API design, backend development, and Python linting/code quality tools.
Identify and fix security vulnerabilities and write efficient, maintainable code.
Ensure adherence to coding standards, best practices, and code review processes.
 AI / GenAI Development: 
Develop and integrate AI/GenAI capabilities using Python into backend applications and business workflows.
Work with LLMs and AI APIs to build intelligent automation, content generation, summarization, classification, and data-processing features.
Develop Python-based services for integrating AI models with existing Django/DRF APIs and backend systems .
Experience with prompt engineering, LLM integration, embeddings, vector databases, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is preferred.
Build and optimize AI-powered workflows while considering accuracy, latency, scalability, security, and cost.
Implement appropriate validation, error handling, logging, and monitoring for AI-powered applications.
 Database and ORM: 
Work with relational databases such as PostgreSQL/MySQL .
Use Django ORM effectively for database operations and application development.
Optimize database performance and ensure data integrity across multiple databases.
Experience with vector databases or vector search technologies for AI/GenAI use cases is a plus.
 Testing and Quality Assurance: 
Write effective unit and integration tests using pytest and Django’s testing framework.
Ensure high test coverage for all core modules.
Develop tests and validation mechanisms for AI-powered features and API integrations.
Ensure application reliability, security, and performance through automated testing.
 Deployment & DevOps: 
Work with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Docker .
Collaborate with DevOps teams on deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Deploy and maintain Python/Django and AI-powered services in cloud or containerized environments.
Monitor application and AI-service performance and troubleshoot production issues.
 Your profile: 
Strong proficiency in Python .
Hands-on experience with Django and Django REST Framework (DRF) .
Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and backend architecture .
Experience with PostgreSQL/MySQL and Django ORM .
Experience with pytest and automated testing .
Good understanding of Git, Docker, CI/CD, and code quality/linting tools .
Hands-on experience integrating AI/GenAI capabilities using Python .
Understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, AI APIs, embeddings, and RAG .
Strong understanding of secure coding practices and vulnerability remediation.
 Good to Have / Added Advantage: 
 Hands-on experience with Java and Java-based backend development .
Knowledge of Spring Boot, Spring Framework, or Java REST APIs .
Experience working with applications involving both Python and Java services.
Exposure to microservices architecture and integration between Python and Java-based systems.
Experience with cloud platforms and modern DevOps practices.
Strong problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills.
